column8: ∀ (ticket : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.Ticket) (height : ℕ), ticket.liveAt height = Bool.true ↔ height ≤ ticket.notAfter

∀ (domain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (resource : ℕ) (page : Minidregg.Kernel.ContentResource.ContentStore) (record : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.AtomRecord), Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.lookup page Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.Namespace.atoms (Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.ticketAtom domain resource) = Option.some record → record.tombstonedAt.isSome = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.decodeInstalled domain resource page = Option.none

∀ (ticket : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.Ticket) (dispatch : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchCodec.Dispatch) (enrollment : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.Enrollment) (schema : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema) (requested : List Bool), Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.eligibleBits ticket dispatch enrollment schema = Option.some requested → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.bitsToNat requested = dispatch.identity.permissionBits

∀ (ticket : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.Ticket) (dispatch : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchCodec.Dispatch) (enrollment : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.Enrollment) (schema : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema) (requested : List Bool), Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.eligibleBits ticket dispatch enrollment schema = Option.some requested → ∃ ceiling, schema.resolve ticket.ceiling = Option.some ceiling ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.withinCeiling requested ceiling

∀ (ticket : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.Ticket) (dispatch : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchCodec.Dispatch) (enrollment : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationGrainSessionEnrollment.Enrollment) (schema : Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.Schema) (requested ceiling : List Bool) (index : ℕ), schema.resolve enrollment.role = Option.some requested → schema.resolve ticket.ceiling = Option.some ceiling → requested[index]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.true → ceiling[index]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.false → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.eligibleBits ticket dispatch enrollment schema = Option.none

∀ {requested ceiling : List Bool}, Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.withinCeilingCheck requested ceiling = Bool.true → ∀ (index : ℕ), requested[index]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.true → ceiling[index]?.getD Bool.false = Bool.true
∀ {requested ceiling : List Bool}, Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.withinCeilingCheck requested ceiling = Bool.true → requested.length = ceiling.length

∀ {requested ceiling : List Bool}, Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationDispatchAuthority.withinCeilingCheck requested ceiling = Bool.true → Minidregg.Kernel.ApplicationPermissionSchema.withinCeiling requested ceiling
